answer: Each new "mirror" identity must post an entry bond priced by a quadratic fee: the n-th identity costs n² × 25 tokens, so 10 fakes cost 6,250 tokens, not 250. Bonds back a "fable" score—if peers refute an agent's attested history, the delta between claimed and observed behavior slashes 40% of every linked identity's bond, making scale-ups exponentially expensive.
